programme.title: Max Attacks!
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Familiar Faces
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: What A Blast!
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Changing Gears
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: And Then There Were Two
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Let The Games Begin Again!
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Runaway Daichi
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Idol
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Out Of Their League
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mystel
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Pros And Ex-Cons
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Boris, The Blade Stops Here!
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: The Bega Challenge
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Bega On The Rise
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Rebel Alliance
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Back To Basics
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: And Justice-Five For All
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: When You Wish Upon A Star
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Sing Ming Ming Sing!
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Refuse To Lose
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Max To The Max
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: The Return Of Kai
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Now Youre Making Me Mad
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: The Beyblading Spirit
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: The Principles Of Victory
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Welcome To My Nightmare!
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Brooklyns Back!
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beybattle For The Ages
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: The Blade Raider
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Day Of The Dragoon
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Take It To The Max!
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: The Qualifier Begins
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Draciel Of Approval
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Dragoon Storm
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Thirteen Candles
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Bladin In The Streets
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Showdown In Hong Kong
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Battle In The Sky
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Bye Bye Bit Beast
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Adios Bladebreakers
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Crouching Lion, Hidden Tiger
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: The Race Is On
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Going For The Gold
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: My Enemy, My Friend
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: A Score To Settle
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Under The Microscope
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Its All Relative
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Blading With The Stars!
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Showdown In Vegas
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: My Way Or The Highway
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Catch A Shooting All-Star
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: The Battle Of America
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Bottom Of The Ninth
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Play It Again Dizzi
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Cruising For A Bruising
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: London Calling
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.sub-title: The World Is Yours - Angkor, Hamburgo & Curacao
programme.desc: We started our expedition in Angkor, Cambodia, in one of the most spiritual ruins in the world, where once there was a city of great religious significance, Angkor Vat. This incredible temple is the largest religious monument in the world. From this thousand-year-old site we will fly to Hamburg, Germany, to get to a modern metropolis. And the largest department store district in the world in which buildings are built in the 19th and early 20th centuries on wooden foundations. And before we say goodbye to Hamburg, well go to the biggest amusement park and tourist center in northern Germany, with the longest mountain of all. Before we finish, we will fly to the island of Curacao, in the Antilles to immerse ourselves in the crystalline blue of the Caribbean Sea, and we will go to the Blue Rim, a very popular attraction for divers of all kinds.

programme.title: The World's Most Remote Hotels
programme.desc: Nestled in a desert valley in the middle of immense dunes, and facing salt marshes, the hotel is revealed with its stone towers, large trellises and water games, resembling an ancient Arab fortress.

programme.title: Neven’s Greenway Food Trails
programme.desc: Cycling through some of Ireland’s most stunning scenery, chef Neven Maguire explores established Greenways such as The Great Western Greenway in Mayo, The Limerick, Waterford and Royal Canal Greenways; and he follows the routes of future Greenways planned for South Kerry and Connemara in Co. Galway. Along the way Neven meets some of Ireland’s most talented food producers and chefs in a variety of interesting locations. Ireland’s Greenways follow the routes of abandoned railway lines and canals which have been revitalised as cycling and walking tracks, passing through dramatic mountainous landscapes, lakeshores and seascapes. On his travels Neven also meets local historians who tell him all about these 19th century feats of engineering which had a transformative impact on the whole country. Many of the original aqueducts, viaducts and tunnels form part of the Greenways today and feature in the series.

programme.title: American Food Battle
programme.desc: American Food Battle follows European chefs Henri Alén and Nicolas Thieulon on a U.S. road trip, challenging local culinary masters and exploring regional flavors.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip steps into famed Japanese celebrity Chef Tetsuya Wakuda’s second outlet, outside the original in Sydney, Waku Ghin at Marina Bay Sands Resort and Casino, voted number 7 in the coveted San Pellegrino World’s 50 Best Restaurants list.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Neven’s Greenway Food Trails
programme.desc: Cycling through some of Ireland’s most stunning scenery, chef Neven Maguire explores established Greenways such as The Great Western Greenway in Mayo, The Limerick, Waterford and Royal Canal Greenways; and he follows the routes of future Greenways planned for South Kerry and Connemara in Co. Galway. Along the way Neven meets some of Ireland’s most talented food producers and chefs in a variety of interesting locations. Ireland’s Greenways follow the routes of abandoned railway lines and canals which have been revitalised as cycling and walking tracks, passing through dramatic mountainous landscapes, lakeshores and seascapes. On his travels Neven also meets local historians who tell him all about these 19th century feats of engineering which had a transformative impact on the whole country. Many of the original aqueducts, viaducts and tunnels form part of the Greenways today and feature in the series.

Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 67: Reinaldo esta vivo: Pierre Dubuois
programme.desc: Inés le ruega a Luis Guillermo que le crea lo que le está contando de que Reinaldo Está Vivo y tiene en la actualidad la identidad de Pierre Dubuois. Pero Luis Guillermo no le cree y dice que va a buscar a Pierre Dubuois y le va a caer a golpes para que le diga la verdad. Por otra lago Gabriela se encuentra con Robert en el Club y le dice que le tiene una primicia que le va a gustar mucho. Que vio a Inés abrazada con un hombre en las puertas de la iglesia. Marta le dice a Inés que Jennifer está sumamente triste por la despedida a Jean Paul. Inés le dice que a Jean Paul lo podemos ver cuando queramos no te pongas triste.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Encuentran a Vespasiano al costado de la carretera y parece estar muerto pero al final está vivo y lo llevan a un hospital donde se recupera. Vicenta le dice a Federico que no lo acompañará en su enfermedad y Christian se enfada y Federico sale de la casa muy asustado de que Christian lo golpee. Inmaculada le pide a Julie que no se vaya pero esta ya está decidida. Julio le dice a Julie que no la acompañará en su viaje, que tiene cosas pendientes que arreglar. Simón le dice a Iris que no es la Viuda Negra y trata de besarla pero Iris no lo deja.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 79: Socorro y Salvador: Un Amor Sin Precio
programme.desc: Salvador está a punto de confesar que es un amante pago y que quien lo prostituyó fue Josefina. Sin embargo Julio César interfiere y le dice a Socorro que el motivo de esa reunión era mostrar cómo lograba sobornar a Salvador para que se alejara de ella pero él no se dejó comprar. Socorro se enoja con su padre por haber intentado tal canallada, pues el amor de ellos no tiene precio. Socorro les pide que no interfieran en su relación y se marcha con Salvador. Josefina no tiene otra que aceptarle a Julio César que ella maneja un negocio de amantes pagos. - Gonzalo se responsabiliza ante Charo de ser el único que maneja Latin Lovers, con el fin de que no se vea manchada la imagen de Josefina para Charo. Charo y Gonzalo se alían para destrozar a Salvador.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 79: Averia en la Lluvia y Secretos Familiares
programme.desc: Marisela y Gabriel se detienen porque el carro tiene una falla y discuten porque Marisela está apurada por llegar rápido a buscar a Ricardo su hijo, que está detenido junto a Gabriela en Las Pomarrosas. Allí, Gabriel la convence de quedarse en el carro, por lo tarde y comienza a llover. Entonces Marisela se pasa al puesto trasero para mantener distancia de Gabriel. Por el frío que les comienza a dar beben Brandy. Al mismo tiempo en la delegación policial del pueblo tienen detenidos a Ricardo y a Gabriela los cuales están recién casados y huyendo en un carro del hermano de Isabela. Aprovechan el momento para reflexionar sobre las dudas del cariño paternal de Gabriel con su hija.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 122: La Boda, El Embarazo y Aristigueta.
programme.desc: Dileidi esta con toda su familia cenando y les hace saber que fue escogida como madrina de la boda de Luís Fernando con la miss. Ella cree que María Gracia es una tonta pero Gladis le advierte que esa niña es más inteligente que todas ellas por la forma en que actuó. Por otro lado, Rosita y José Tadeo que se enteraron de la boda de Luís Fernando y están comiendo con el, quieren saber todo sobre la boda y sus motivos. Egleé se disculpa y se para de la mesa para asistir a un compromiso, no sin salvarse de las ironías de su hija Cristinita. Matilde decide dormir en el sofá de su casa y se lo hace saber a Gonzalo. El no lo puede aceptar pero Matilde le hace saber sus razones que son que el piensa que ella no es buena madre con sus hijos. Egleé y Santiago mantienen un encuentro amoroso y Egleé aprovecha para preguntarle sobre el encuentro que tuvo el con Rómulo en el baño. Mientras que Rómulo se encuentra en su casa con Betzaida viendo una película, pero lo menos que está haciendo es poniendo atención a la película y lo que hace es imaginarse el encuentro que tuvo con Santiago en el baño ese día. Al día siguiente Rómulo decide ir a la casa de Egleé muy temprano. Es recibido por Egleé y para su asombro este le reclama la relación que lleva con Santiago. Egleé lo toma muy deportivamente y lo único que hace es reírse de él. Rómulo se marcha de la casa de Egleé muy molesto por la actitud que tuvo Egleé. Santiago en su casa conversa con su abuelo acerca el amor que siente por Egleé. Mientras en casa de Gladis recibe la visita de Doroteo y este le propone que este muy vigilante de cualquier papel que vea acerca de Aristigueta para poder así desenmascarar a Aristigueta y hacerle pagar todo lo que a echo. La Nena que esta muy apurada para ir a dar sus clases que son pagadas, recibe la visita de Aristigueta y le pide que firme unos papeles. La Nena lo hace sin ver que está firmando por lo apurada que está. Luego de eso Aristigueta le hace la salvedad de que no debe firmar nada sin leerlo antes, pero que con el no se preocupe, solo era un consejo. La Nena queda muy preocupada. José Tadeo visita a Luís Fernando porque el quiere saber la razones reales por la que se casa su nieto y se entera de que es porque María Gracia está embarazada. José Tadeo se alegra mucho porque tiene un gran macho en su familia. Aureliano en la oficina se entera a través de Dileidi que ella va a ser la madrina de la boda y se burla mucho de ella, pero ella le reafirma que no va a dejar que Luís Fernando se case con la miss. Llega Luís Fernando y trata de hablar con Dileidi pero Aureliano no pierde la oportunidad para burlarse de él también. Monchito llega a la obra con Matilde y se da cuenta que ella está rara, y le pregunta. Ella le cuenta el problemón que tuvo con Gonzalo la noche anterior y Monchito a su vez le cuenta a Matilde que fue amenazado de muerte por Pascuita si a el se le ocurría llamar al Psicólogo que Matilde les había recomendado para el caso de bulimia de Felicita. En la oficina Gonzalo y Yenilú se encuentra conversando muy animadamente y son vistos por Pascuita. Esta se alegra mucho por ver que Gonzalo como que le está siendo infiel a Matilde y se alegra mucho y se lo hace saber a Gladis que está allí limpiando. Aristigueta llega a la oficina y saluda muy efusivamente a Pascuita sin darse cuenta de que allí está Gladis. Doroteo le cuenta a Gabito el plan que le puso a Gladis para desenmascarar a Aristigueta. Marco Aurelio se reúne con Aristigueta para el proyecto del centro comercial y le pide a Gladis que está allí limpiando que le saque fotocopia a los documentos que trajo Aristigueta ya que Egleé no la encuentra. Gladis piensa que a lo mejor esa es la gran oportunidad para tener las pruebas de quién es Aristigueta. Gabito que sigue conversando con Doroteo sobre la proposición de Doroteo a Gladis, le advierte que si el la mete en algún problema el es capaz de matarlo. Gladis se va a la oficina para sacar la fotocopia pero como ella no sabe manejar la fotocopiadora le da unas instrucciones erradas y comienza a sacar muchas copias. Llega Egleé y se da cuenta y la ayuda, y se da cuenta que son documentos de Aristigueta, y se encarga de eso, no permitiendo que Gladis pueda tener una copia de esos documentos. La Nena le cuenta a Rosita lo que le paso con la firma de los papeles que le llevo Aristigueta, Rosita le advierte todo lo que puede pasarle. Luís Fernando le cuenta a Santiago toda sus preocupaciones que tiene por el echo de que Dileidi es la madrina de la boda. Santiago lo único que hace es burlarse de el. Yenilú ve a Dileidi actuando en forma muy rara por lo de la boda, pero Dileidi le reitera que ella va a impedir esa boda porque ella sigue amando a su novio Luís Fernando.

Ella le cuenta el problemón que tuvo con Gonzalo la noche anterior y Monchito a su vez le cuenta a Matilde que fue amenazado de muerte por Pascuita si a el se le ocurría llamar al Psicólogo que Matilde les había recomendado para el caso de bulimia de Felicita. En la oficina Gonzalo y Yenilú se encuentra conversando muy animadamente y son vistos por Pascuita. Esta se alegra mucho por ver que Gonzalo como que le está siendo infiel a Matilde y se alegra mucho y se lo hace saber a Gladis que está allí limpiando. Aristigueta llega a la oficina y saluda muy efusivamente a Pascuita sin darse cuenta de que allí está Gladis. Doroteo le cuenta a Gabito el plan que le puso a Gladis para desenmascarar a Aristigueta. Marco Aurelio se reúne con Aristigueta para el proyecto del centro comercial y le pide a Gladis que está allí limpiando que le saque fotocopia a los documentos que trajo Aristigueta ya que Egleé no la encuentra. Gladis piensa que a lo mejor esa es la gran oportunidad para tener las pruebas de quién es Aristigueta. Gabito que sigue conversando con Doroteo sobre la proposición de Doroteo a Gladis, le advierte que si el la mete en algún problema el es capaz de matarlo. Gladis se va a la oficina para sacar la fotocopia pero como ella no sabe manejar la fotocopiadora le da unas instrucciones erradas y comienza a sacar muchas copias. Llega Egleé y se da cuenta y la ayuda, y se da cuenta que son documentos de Aristigueta, y se encarga de eso, no permitiendo que Gladis pueda tener una copia de esos documentos. La Nena le cuenta a Rosita lo que le paso con la firma de los papeles que le llevo Aristigueta, Rosita le advierte todo lo que puede pasarle. Luís Fernando le cuenta a Santiago toda sus preocupaciones que tiene por el echo de que Dileidi es la madrina de la boda. Santiago lo único que hace es burlarse de el. Yenilú ve a Dileidi actuando en forma muy rara por lo de la boda, pero Dileidi le reitera que ella va a impedir esa boda porque ella sigue amando a su novio Luís Fernando.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 67: Reinaldo esta vivo: Pierre Dubuois
programme.desc: Inés le ruega a Luis Guillermo que le crea lo que le está contando de que Reinaldo Está Vivo y tiene en la actualidad la identidad de Pierre Dubuois. Pero Luis Guillermo no le cree y dice que va a buscar a Pierre Dubuois y le va a caer a golpes para que le diga la verdad. Por otra lago Gabriela se encuentra con Robert en el Club y le dice que le tiene una primicia que le va a gustar mucho. Que vio a Inés abrazada con un hombre en las puertas de la iglesia. Marta le dice a Inés que Jennifer está sumamente triste por la despedida a Jean Paul. Inés le dice que a Jean Paul lo podemos ver cuando queramos no te pongas triste.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Salomón se embriaga y encuentra todas las muñecas sin ojos de Inmaculada desparramadas por su casa. De repente, la viuda negra lo ataca y lo deja mal herido, casi a punto de morir. Alejandro se presenta en la casa de Ignacio, un maestro que el tuvo en la academia cuando estudió para ser detective. Su propósito es pedirle ayuda para tratar de resolver el caso de la viuda negra. Cuando los detectives encuentran a Salomón en el sillón de su casa, se dan cuenta de que aún está vivo. Alejandro le pregunta si sabe quién fue la persona que lo atacó, y Salomón declaró que Inmaculada fue la culpable. No logran salvar a Salomón, y éste muere en la ambulancia rumbo al hospital. Es por eso que, debido a la declaración, Inmaculada es sospechosa por homicidio.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 80: Socorro Descubre la Verdad de Salvador
programme.desc: Salvador llega a cumplir la cita a la mujer árabe y a quien encuentra es a Socorro con el traje árabe. Socorro está destrozada, no puede creer que Salvador sea un gigoló. Ella le cuenta que a pesar de que se negó a creerlo en un principio Charo fue la persona que le abrió los ojos y la llevó hasta el hotel para comprobarlo. Socorro le pidió a Charo que la dejara simular ser la mujer que le pagaría a Salvador un millón de dólares. Gonzalo, por otra parte, le informa a Josefina lo que debe estar viviendo Cocó en ese momento y que su cómplice fue Charo. Josefina tampoco puede creer que se hubieran atrevido a hacerle ese daño a Socorro. Gonzalo está convencido que todo lo hizo por el bien de ella, pero Josefina está furiosa con él.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 80: Boda, Adopcion y Muerte Calcinada
programme.desc: Marisela y Gabriel llegando a la comisaría donde se encuentra Gabriela y Ricardo detenidos, se enteran de que estos últimos se han casado. Marisela se desmaya al saber la noticia. Cuando vuelve a la conciencia, le dice a Ricardo que ese matrimonio tienen que disolverlo porque hay un inconveniente con Gabriela. Gabriela cree que ella se refiere a que ella es adoptada, declara que sabe la razón de que ese matrimonio no puede ser. Marisela al oír que ella es adoptada se tranquiliza pues ya entre Ricardo y ella no habría ningún inconveniente de parentesco. Luego, Ricardo le pide a Marisela vivir con Gabriela en su casa. Marisela le cuenta a Ricardo el accidente que ha ocurrido, y que su papá murió calcinado.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 123: Un beso, una trampa y un error
programme.desc: Yenilú conversa con Dileidi sobre Luís Fernando y en ese momento llega Luís Fernando y Santiago. Ellas actúan y despistan a Luís Fernando. Por otro lado en casa de Pascuita están Cristinita, Alegría, Felicita y Tatianita preparándole la fiesta de despedida de soltera a María Gracia mientras ella no para de hablar de cuanto se aman Luís Fernando y ella. Doroteo lleva a Pascuita a la consulta del brujo Ángel. Doroteo le pide el diez por ciento a Ángel sobre lo que cobre de la consulta. Pascuita en un principio no está muy convencida de Ángel pero el le comienza a decir ciertas cosas y Pascuita se las cree, sin saber ella que todo lo que le dice el brujo es pura mentira porque el no sabe nada de eso. En la oficina Gonzalo trata de arreglar las cosas con Matilde pero ella sigue muy molesta con el y lo rechaza, entonces Gonzalo se acerca a Monchito y a Rómulo y le hace comentarios a ellos acerca de Matilde, pero lo que no sabe Gonzalo es la relación que tiene Monchito con su mujer. Yenilú y Aureliano se burlan de Dileidi por la boda que se va a realizar de Luís Fernando. Se les une Gladis y Dileidi se molesta y se va de allí dejándolos solos dirigiéndose Dileidi a la sala de conferencia en donde está Luís Fernando. Ya allí le pregunta el por qué se va a casar con María Gracia amándola a ella. El le pide que confié en el y ella se encuentra muy confundida. El la besa de sorpresa muy apasionadamente. Al terminar ese beso Dileidi le pide que por favor no hablen de nada y que sigan con el proyecto. Por otro lado, siguen reunidas las muchachas preparando la fiesta y reciben la visita de la mamá de María Gracia. Ella se emociona mucho por su presencia y se las presenta a todas. La mamá de María Gracia al terminar de presentárselas las trata con mucha amabilidad pero no sin antes pensar que ellas están muerta de la envidia por quitarle el novio a su hijita pero ella no lo va a permitir. Pascuita llega a la oficina y ve a Monchito y a Matilde muy acaramelados y se les acerca sin que se den cuenta. Monchito y Matilde son sorprendidos pero actúan disimuladamente. Pascuita convida a Matilde a tomarse un café porque quiere conversar con ella. Matilde acepta. Rómulo llega a la oficina con una bolsa de regalos que se la da a Betzaida para que los vea. Ella está muy emocionada por el detalle que tuvo Rómulo hacia el hijo que van a tener. Egleé y Santiago los observan y Egleé comenta que Rómulo está muy detallista pero que si lo hubiera visto esa mañana, muy furiosos y advirtiéndole que se iba a aburrir igual que ahora cuando tuvieran veinte años juntos, pero se lo cuenta a Santiago con mucha risa. Santiago en cambio le responde a Egleé que a él si le gustaría estar con ella veinte años. Egleé se imagina la situación dentro de veinte años y se ve anciana y el invitándola a bailar, no lo puede creer. Santiago ve la cara de asombro de Egleé y se da cuenta y le comenta que el no debería pensar esas cosas, porque el siempre ha estado caído de una nube. Egleé le explica que ella no lo está rechazando y que ella prefiere vivir el presente y lo convida a salir de la oficina juntos. Por otro lado, Aureliano y Gladis aprovechan que Egleé se fue de la oficina para agarrar la carpeta de los documentos de Aristigueta. En un restaurante lujoso está una amiga de la Nena con Aristigueta almorzando. El aprovecha para averiguar sobre el incidente que tuvo la Nena con un mesonero de allí y descubre que ese mesonera era nada menos y nada más que Doroteo y que todavía seguía vivo y lo tenía que resolver. Doroteo esta en la bodega con Gabito hablando y llegan Aureliano y Gladis con la carpeta y se la muestran a Doroteo. Están muy alegres porque supuestamente pueden comprometer a Aristigueta, pero lo que contiene la carpeta es facturas y recibos de teléfonos, sustrajeron la carpeta equivocada. Dileidi llama a María Gracia para verse y esta acepta pero María Gracia le dice a donde. Cuando Dileidi llega al sitio, que es un edificio, entran al ascensor y María Gracia tranca el ascensor a propósito. Dileidi se pone nerviosa pero María Gracia le deja muy claro que Luís Fernando la tiene a en un pedestal a ella, pero que se olvide porque quien tiene en sus brazos es a María Gracia y le pide que no se le olvide. Dileidi sigue muy nerviosa y salen del ascensor. Cuando entra a la casa ve a Felicita, Tatianita y Cristinita y se pone aun más nerviosa pero María Gracia le explica que la llevo a su despida de soltera. Allí conoce a la mamá de María Gracia y le comenta que ella la quiere mucho y que su hija la considera su mejor amiga. Aureliano, Doroteo y Gladis llegan a la oficina pero el vigilante no los quiere dejar pasar, pero lo convence y entran. Ya allí van a la oficina de Marco Aurelio y comienzan a revisar las cosas para ver si encuentran los documentos. Gladis se encuentra muy nerviosa. Escuchan unas voces y Gladis los identifica como Aristigueta y Marco Aurelio y se esconden debajo del escritorio muy nerviosos. Marco Aurelio conversa con Aristigueta afuera sobre el proyecto y piensa que no se imagina que el terreno de Aristigueta se lo está cuidando Doroteo. Por otro lado, en la oficina de Marco Aurelio siguen Gladis, Doroteo y Aureliano tratando de pensar en lo que van hacer si son descubierto allí.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 68: Reinaldo se revela como hermano
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo se reúne con Pierre Dubuois (Reinaldo) y le habla de los planes magníficos que acaba de perder. La Gerencia de Aruba y su matrimonio con Daniela. Reinaldo le dice que tiene que tener cosas importantes como para haber abandonado ese proyecto tan magnífico. El le dice que sí, Que para aceptar esos planes había la condición de casarse con Daniela. El no quería casarse con Daniela porque el estaba enamoradísimo de la viuda de su hermano fallecido Reinaldo. Reinaldo al oír esto, se levanta de la mesa y habla con su propia voz. Luis Guillermo le dice que era la única forma de que se descubriera y lo saluda como hermano.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York in Twenty Years
programme.desc: Tony sets out to find the real Singapore, with its multicultural restaurants and food markets. He samples prescription food dishes, explores the Geyland Serai Market, and rides the clean and efficient local subway.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Join Tony on his quest to characterize the perfect bar in New York City. Discover the importance of a maniacal bartender, the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late-night snacks.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Puebla, Where the Good Cooks Are From
programme.desc: Puebla, Mexico: According to Tony, the best line cooks in NYC come from Mexico, so he travels to the Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque (a slightly hallucinogenic drink made from cactus sap).

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Oaxaca, Mexico: Chef Tony Bourdain explores the exotic and colorful indigenous zone of Mexico's Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies. His adventure ends with mariachi music and, of course, lots of tequila.

programme.title: Culinary Travels With Dave Eckert
programme.desc: Culinary Travels is taking on the sights and flavors of Scotland. We will discover local steaks and seafood, as well as tasty single malt scotch outside of Glasgow before we explore Scotland's history in Edinburgh's Prestonfield House.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Alila Villas Uluwatu is a magical 5-star resort set atop steep cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. Executive Chef Stephane Simond prepares stunning dishes served at Alila's two high end restaurants CIRE and The Warung.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Malaysia's extraordinary restaurants can be found in the most amazing locations, and Phillip Davenport takes us to the best of them. Dato' Steve Day nurtured the country's progress towards culinary excellence, and here, we taste Malaysia.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip Davenport heads to Gunther's to meet with Owner Gunther Hubrechsen who thrives on simplicity and fresh ingredients when it comes to his modern French cuisine. Join Chef Hubrechsen in his kitchen as he prepares his signature dishes.

programme.title: Primal Grill with Steven Raichlen

programme.title: The New Environmentalists

programme.title: Wings of Kyrgyzstan

programme.title: The Silk Road
programme.desc: In ancient times, caravanners considered themselves safely in China only after they had first successfully negotiated the treacherous Taklamakan desert. In the dunes of Dunhuang, you will meet a camel breeder, and stretching outward from Dunhuang, witness The Valley of the 1000 Buddhas.

programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva es la primera belleza de la ciudad. Hace tiempo que se ha acostumbrado a la idea de que todo el mundo se interesa sólo por su aspecto. Está rodeada de flores y admiradores, muchos pretendientes. El bandido local Zhukov tampoco pudo resistirse a ella, pero Anna se mantiene inaccesible: no le gusta Zhukov. Contrata a unos matones para que den una lección de venganza a la terca belleza. Un transeúnte, Andrei Savin, es testigo del ataque y defiende a la chica. Inesperadamente, Anna se enamora de Andrei. Al enterarse de la aventura de Anna, Zhukov se enfurece. Al descubrir que su antigua amante está embarazada, le dice a Andrei que el bebé es supuestamente suyo, de Zhukov. Andrei intenta averiguar la verdad, pero Anna, ofendida por su desconfianza, declara que efectivamente está embarazada del bandido. Andrei la deja, Anna aborta. Si hubiera podido adivinar a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Zhukov le dice a Andrei que el hijo de Anna es suyo. Andrei cree el rumor, lo que provoca que Anna termine la relación y aborte. Udalov asesina a Gushin, pero antes de morir, este logra decirle a Andrei el nombre de su asesino. Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Monster High: Electrified
programme.desc: When Clawdeen dreams of opening a salon made for monsters and normies, Frankie has the perfect place - an abandoned power station outside town. But the idea sparks negative voltage when Moanica plots to ruin the whole thing and replace the celebration with something a little more... shocking!

programme.title: Monster High: Freaky Fusion
programme.desc: When the ghouls travel back in time to learn about Frankie's scaritage, they run into trouble when the time machine accidentally fuses eight of the ghouls into four hybrid monsters! Get ready for a clash of fang and fur!

programme.title: Monster High Adventures of the Ghoul Squad
programme.desc: Get ready for a voltageous time! The ghouls are back like you’ve never seen them before in this action-packed adventure! Draculaura, Frankie, Clawdeen, and their ghoulfriends combine their wits and monsteriffic abilities as they travel to exotic locations, solve spine-tingling mysteries, and rescue monsters who are hiding from a world that fears and doesn’t understand them. So how do you track these missing monsters down and bring them back to their new home at Monster High? You call The Ghoul Squad!

programme.title: Barbie Doll Adventures
programme.desc: Welcome to Doll World! A beautiful place where all dolls live and play in harmony with a shared goal of inspiring future generations of girls to dream big and be anything! When the very first and most iconic Barbie fashion doll is missing, Barbie & Barbie set out on an exciting adventure to find the missing outfit!

programme.title: Barbie Life in the City

Back in town we we board the Nau Santa Maria - a replica of Christopher Columbus' sailboat.
